subject: Asynchronous handoff & deep-dive planning for StratoTech POC
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chan <emily.chan@stratotech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Asynchronous handoff & deep-dive planning for StratoTech POC

Hi Emily / team —

Thanks again for agreeing to a hands-on POC with Redwood. To keep momentum and avoid painful timezone ping-pong, I wanted to propose an asynchronous handoff + rotating deep-dive cadence that covers US / EU / APAC with dedicated working sessions for: prompt review, routing tests (fallback/variant routing), and a light load/latency rehearsal.

High-level proposal (please pick preferred windows):
- Week 0 (kickoff): 90m kickoff (walkthrough of mutual action plan, infra checklist, accounts/keys)
- Weeks 1–2 (hands-on): three 60m technical deep-dives, each focused on one area: prompts, routing/fallbacks, and load rehearsal. Sessions rotate so each session has at least one US-friendly and one APAC/EU-friendly slot over two weeks.

Suggested template times (all shown in local equivalents in the attached grid):
A) 08:00 PT / 11:00 ET / 16:00 BST — works well for early US + EU overlap
B) 15:00 PT / 23:00 CET / 06:00 SGT — late EU, early APAC option for APAC engineers
C) 22:00 PT / 07:00 CET / 13:00 SGT (next day) — APAC-friendly window with US evening coverage

Attachments: StratoTech_MUTUAL_action_plan_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan + owners), rotating-availability-grid.csv (local time conversions), loadtest-runbook-draft.md (baseline runbook).

Request: could you share the core working-team members and a quick pointer to which of the three windows (A/B/C) you prefer for the initial two weeks? Once we have preferences I’ll coordinate calendar invites and a short runbook for the load rehearsal (we’ll limit the rehearsal to light synthetic traffic — no production data).

I’ll loop Marissa (ops) and Jasmine (solutions) to capture availability and owner assignments.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

—
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Emily Chan <emily.chan@stratotech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: StratoTech POC Team <poc@stratotech.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:37:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Asynchronous handoff & deep-dive planning for StratoTech POC

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear plan. Our core squad for the POC will be: myself (EM), Dev Lead: Miguel Santos (miguel.s@stratotech.com), Platform Eng: Priya Rao (priya.r@stratotech.com), and Product: Alex Wu (alex.w@stratotech.com).

Preferences:
- Kickoff: Window A works best for us for a recorded kickoff (08:00 PT / 16:00 BST).
- Deep-dives: We prefer a rotation that prioritizes at least one APAC-friendly session per week — Window C for the prompt review (so Priya can attend), Window A for routing, and Window B for the load rehearsal (we can have a small overnight on-call for that).

A couple of asks: can you confirm the expected test data footprint for the load rehearsal? We want to ensure our NAT/egress rules allow the synthetic traffic. Also, could you add a short section in the action plan about how Redwood will handle KV/prefix caching during the routing tests?

Happy to confirm once I get Miguel & Priya’s final times this afternoon.

Best,
Emily
Emily Chan
Head of Platform POCs — StratoTech
emily.chan@stratotech.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chan <emily.chan@stratotech.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Asynchronous handoff & deep-dive planning for StratoTech POC

Emily —

Appreciate the quick preferences. I synced with our infra team and added notes to the mutual action plan about the load rehearsal footprint: for an initial light run we expect ~200 concurrent virtual users over a 10-minute burst (~5k tokens/sec peak), all synthetic prompts (no customer data). If you want a larger stress run we can scope separately.

I’ve attached a rotating-availability-grid.csv with each session’s local times and a recommended rotation matrix that minimizes late-night repeats for any single engineer. Quick summary of what I’ll calendar:
- Kickoff: Thu 24 Jul, 08:00 PT / 16:00 BST — 90m — invite pending (owner: Karthik)
- Prompt review (Session 1): Mon 28 Jul, Window C — 60m — owner: Jasmine
- Routing/fallbacks (Session 2): Wed 30 Jul, Window A — 60m — owner: Karthik
- Load rehearsal (Session 3): Fri 1 Aug, Window B — 75m (includes 15m warmup + 10m burst) — owner: Marissa

Attachments: rotating-availability-grid.csv (available windows matrix). I’ll create shared calendar invites with the agenda and include the runbook draft link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDEFghIJkLMnoPqrsTUV

Small operational notes:
- Please ensure the firewall/NAT egress rules permit outbound to the Redwood test collector IPs (listed in the action plan).
- We’ll supply a short prompt set (5–8 prompts) for the prompt review session; Jasmine will follow up with a doc where we’ll both paste canonical prompts and a few regression checks.

If the dates above look off for your team, flag them and I’ll reschedule.

– Marissa
Marissa Cole
Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chan <emily.chan@stratotech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 17:04:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Asynchronous handoff & deep-dive planning for StratoTech POC

Emily / team —

This is great — thanks for the confirmations. I’ve gone ahead and:
- Sent the kickoff invite (Thu 24 Jul, 08:00 PT / 16:00 BST, 90m) to the distribution you shared.
- Created calendar placeholders for the three deep-dive sessions with owners and agenda bullets; invites will include dial-in + recording.
- Added a short section to the mutual action plan about KV/prefix caching behavior during routing tests (see attached updated action plan).

Action owners and next steps:
- Emily / StratoTech: confirm final attendees (Miguel / Priya / Alex) in the kickoff invite and confirm firewall egress for tester IPs.
- Marissa: finalize the loadtest runbook and post the link (owner).
- Jasmine: draft the prompt review doc and share with StratoTech by EOD Friday.
- Karthik: will run the kickoff and cover rollout/rollback/fallback policies.

If anything else crops up I’ll adjust the rotation. Looking forward to the sessions — we’ll keep things recorded for anyone who can’t make their local window.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
